title: Eye icon on Roles list opens the Permission Summary
expected: Click the eye icon in the Senior SA row Actions column -> a modal opens showing all CRUD/Page Access/Settings/WO subs/View mode/Cross-Cutting for Sr SA matching the matrix; all controls read-only
actual: Opened Senior Service Advisor's Permission Summary. It is read-only (0 enabled/interactive controls) and grouped into all sections (Work orders, Schedule, Customer, Part sales, Catalog, Vendor, Invoicing, Timesheets, Page Access, Settings, View mode, Cross-Cutting, Reports) rendering the Sr SA permission set. HOWEVER Senior Service Advisor is an EDITABLE system role so it has NO direct eye icon in the Actions column (row shows pencil + three-dot); the summary is opened via the three-dot menu -> 'View Permissions', and it opens as a /roles-permissions/{id}/summary panel.
reason: Stale case - behavior OK: the read-only Permission Summary opens and matches Sr SA, but for editable roles there is no direct eye icon (View Permissions is inside the three-dot menu per case 26310). Access path relocated. Not logged.

title: Permission Summary is accessible from the Staff page next to the role selector
expected: On Staff page, open role selector, select Foreman, click 'View Permissions' -> read-only Permission Summary matching Foreman
actual: Staff page (/administration/staff) opened; each staff row has an edit_note action. After opening a staff record, a 'Role' selector is present (value shows current role, e.g. 'Role Admin') and a 'View Permissions' affordance exists on the staff surface. However the staff-edit panel/role-selector could not be driven reliably via automation to select Foreman and open the summary this session.
reason: Could not fully automate the staff-edit role-selector -> select Foreman -> View Permissions -> summary flow. Role selector + View Permissions affordance confirmed present; the summary feature itself is verified read-only/grouped via the roles-list path (26357/26358/26359). Needs manual/interactive verification. Not logged.

reason: Office's direct eye icon opens the read-only Permission Summary for Office.

title: Permission Summary content is grouped and shows ON/OFF state for every setting
expected: Content grouped (CRUD areas, Page Access, Settings sub-toggles, View mode, Cross-Cutting) and every setting clearly labeled with its ON/OFF state
actual: Opened Service Manager Permission Summary. Content is grouped into all sections: Work orders, Schedule, Customer, Part sales, Catalog & Inventory, Vendor & order management, Invoicing & Payments, Timesheets, Page Access, Settings, View mode, Cross-Cutting, Reports. Every setting's ON/OFF state is shown via read-only (disabled) toggle/checkbox controls (17 toggles + 25 checkboxes) whose checked/unchecked (aria-checked true/false) state indicates ON vs OFF; View mode shows Full View vs Tech view. Controls are non-interactive (read-only).
reason: Summary groups all setting categories and shows each setting's ON/OFF state via read-only checked/unchecked controls.
